eyebrow: A system where batch was never an option
code:
Functional:      score every transaction within ~200ms
Non-functional:  stay available under load -- a hiccup
                 should degrade gracefully, never double-score
caption: Streaming, full stop. One Kappa pipeline, no batch layer.

code:
MERGE INTO TransactionScores AS target
USING (SELECT @transaction_id, @score) AS source
ON target.transaction_id = source.transaction_id
WHEN NOT MATCHED THEN INSERT (...)
-- WHEN MATCHED: do nothing -- already scored
caption: Scoring the same transaction twice is a no-op, not new fraud.

code:
During a partition:
  Refuse to score  --> blocks legitimate purchases (CP)
  Score anyway     --> slightly stale features, but works (AP)
caption: This design deliberately picks AP -- Lesson 19's analysis.
